verdict.rationale: React's docs show a data-flow-driven update model (passing new data on interaction, then React updates the UI) which aligns with explicit unidirectional state flow, but the evidence pack never explicitly discusses one-way vs two-way binding, state traceability, or debugging predictability as a design goal. Missing for 10: explicit docs/discussion of unidirectional data flow, comparison to two-way binding, and independent commentary on debuggability of state changes.
